extracted.name: Cranberry Orange Muffins
extracted.description: Great muffins to get you in the festive holidays! This recipe was given to me by my friend Doris.
instruction_lines: Pre heat oven 425 Add liners to muffin tray
In a large bowl mix together flour, salt, and baking powder. Set aside
In a medium bowl whisk together all other ingredients. Then slowly add the dry ingredients whisking constantly. Mix until combined and then fold in the cranberries.

Bake at 425 for 5 minutes then 375 for 13-15 or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out dry. Add white sparkling sugar on top or I like to add a little cinnamon sugar! To reheat 30 seconds in microwave Enjoy!
